data.action: 漫步在枫林落叶小径上，单手伸手接住飘落的红枫，回眸温柔微笑
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 金秋枫林中的漫步沉思】卡西米尔郊外金秋时节的枫树林中，金红色的落叶铺满了林间石子小径。薇薇安娜裹着温暖的驼色羊毛风衣与米色高领毛衣，金色的鹿角间俏皮地戴着一顶贝雷帽。她伸出戴着皮手套的手掌，轻轻接住一片飘落的红枫，侧脸美得宛如油画——「秋天总是让人不由自主地想写诗呢。博士，能陪我走完这段小径吗？」
data.lighting: 穿透金黄枫叶树冠的柔和斑驳暖阳与落叶反射光
data.location: 郊外金红枫树林落叶小径
data.promptProse: Strolling through a breathtaking golden autumn maple forest bathed in afternoon warmth, Viviana Droste wanders along a cobblestone path carpeted with crimson and amber fallen leaves. She wears a cozy camel-wool trench coat over a cream cable-knit turtleneck and pleated midi skirt, with a soft beret nestled elegantly between her golden antlers. Reaching out a gloved hand to gently catch a drifting red maple leaf, she turns back with a tranquil and radiant smile. A masterfully composed cowboy shot captures the rich autumnal colors, soft dappled sunlight, and timeless romantic charm in pristine anime film still quality.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 金秋枫林中的漫步沉思
